title: Return Type Annotation
instructions:
What does `: String` mean in this function?

```
fun greet(name: String): String
```

options.text: The function returns a String value
The function only accepts strings as input

explanation: The `: String` after the parentheses is the return type. It tells Kotlin that this function gives back a String value when it is called. The parameter type (`name: String` inside the parentheses) is a separate thing -- that tells Kotlin what type of input the function expects.
